label: BCOR::CCNB3
tumor_contexts: BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma of bone or soft tissue

sections.text: BCOR encodes a transcriptional corepressor associated with noncanonical Polycomb repression.
CCNB3 encodes cyclin B3, a regulator of cell-cycle progression.
An X-chromosome inversion joins BCOR to CCNB3 and creates an abnormal transcriptional/chromatin-regulatory product. It defines a distinct round-cell sarcoma that often affects adolescent males.
BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma had better survival than CIC-rearranged sarcoma in the retrospective GRACefUl cohort; many patients received Ewing-type chemotherapy.
